option_relations.rationale: Foreign body aspiration is a cause of aspirational pneumonia, but not aspirational pneumonia itself. The option describes the cause, not the disease.

Obstructive pneumonia due to bronchial foreign body (fish bone) is a specific type of pneumonia, but not aspirational pneumonia itself. The option describes a specific etiology and type of pneumonia, not the general aspirational pneumonia.
Post-obstructive pneumonia secondary to an endobronchial lesion is a type of pneumonia, but not aspirational pneumonia. The option describes a different etiology and type of pneumonia.
Pneumonia is a broader category that includes aspirational pneumonia as a subtype.
